entries.title: Roll hacking checks your way
entries.summary: Use a skill from the character sheet or set up your own dice rules. You can decide whether high or low rolls succeed and whether the best or worst die counts.

entries.title: Start quickly or save a challenge for later
entries.summary: Need a check right now? Pick a difficulty with Quick Hack. For bigger moments, save a full challenge and reuse it in terminals, files, messages, or security cameras.

entries.title: Works with more game systems
entries.summary: Built-in skill checks now work with D&D 5e, Pathfinder 2e, Starfinder 2e, Call of Cthulhu 7e, and Cyberpunk RED, with clearer setup along the way.

entries.title: Galaxy Map 2.0 is here
entries.summary: Build your galaxy directly on the map, open systems to add planets and stations, connect destinations with routes, and let the crew request travel together. Older maps are upgraded when the primary GM opens the world.

entries.title: Cleaner camera feeds
entries.summary: Hidden or outdated token projections no longer linger in a live camera feed, so players only see what is really there.

entries.title: Keep writing while messages update
entries.summary: CyberCall now keeps your unfinished message and cursor position when the conversation refreshes, so an incoming update no longer clears what you were typing.

entries.title: Put contracts on the Galaxy Map
entries.summary: Choose a scene for a contract and link that scene to a Galaxy Map location. Published bounty details then appear on the map, where you can open the full contract directly.

entries.title: More control over critical cut-ins
entries.summary: Choose the die, decide whether high or low results are good, and give each character their own success and failure thresholds.

entries.title: Fewer accidental cut-ins
entries.summary: Old chat rolls, damage rolls, discarded dice, and rerolls no longer set off an animation when they should not.

entries.title: Open evidence right from its card
entries.summary: Click an evidence image on a CSI item card to open the full preview while you are working through the case.

entries.title: Arrange the launcher your way
entries.summary: Press and hold an app, drag it where you want it, and HoloSuite remembers the order for you. Moving apps is steadier now, too, so tiles no longer jump back and forth while you drag.

entries.title: Build tactical blueprints from your scenes
entries.summary: Turn a Foundry scene into a clean, multi-floor schematic. Add rooms, markers, and freehand notes, share a player view, export a PNG, or publish it inside HoloSuite Terminal.

entries.title: Build vending machines that fit your world
entries.summary: Place a shop in a scene, choose its look, stock it with items, set prices and limits, and control who can use it through Foundry Regions.

entries.title: Turn a terminal into a place players can explore
entries.summary: Fill terminals with mail, files, cameras, and useful tools. Add logins, permissions, hacking challenges, downloads, and a look that suits the location.

entries.title: Give hidden targets a proper scanner reveal
entries.summary: Place secrets for the crew to find, then reveal them with a cinematic scanner pulse. You control visibility and range, and it works with any game system.

entries.title: Keep every ship loadout in one place
entries.summary: Build a ship profile, place equipment in its slots, manage power and damage, and choose what the crew is allowed to install or switch on.
